data.description:

Mochi Mochi is a professional, legitimate Shiatsu massage and spa with both male and female clients; great reviews on Google Maps primarily left by tourists. Offers free tea and great service - Yumi has been tasked with only servicing male clients, and has a few special rooms with mats on the floor for this.
